title: Fuse full QQ16 recovery from 336 to 224 native calls
body:
The full PR #2707 recovery word transports every future-logger field into and out of its query frame, although the logger reads 104 ports and writes only eight. This contribution replaces that block with an owned rectangular correction and preserves all 224 original outputs in F17.

The complete local bill changes from 336 to **224 H1 children**, from 672 to **448 native wrappers**, and from 464 to **352 cover maps**. It adds **1,344 scalar allowance** (27,184 total) and **112 owned full-cover temporary arrays**, all returned zero in identity frame. All 224 current X/Y fields stay borrowed and unchanged. Owner-private peak remains 16. The literal removals are the 104 query-source return transports and eight response-entry transports; the original predecessor and F0-inverse suffix remain intact.

`PROOF.md` gives the ordered operator identity and exact ownership/lifetime bill. `WORD.json` contains the complete 3,935-event replacement word. The verifier authenticates 22 canonical inputs before reusing the credited source algebra, replays the whole word on both original and independent-current routed symbols, checks all 73 frame coordinates at each ADD, and verifies both signed native kernels on 114,688 basis columns with all 224 occurrences bound to their recipes. Eight semantic failure controls cover native offset, maps, sign, ownership, dirty initialization and zero return.

Validation: normal and optimized read-only replay; Git-free export with no executable search path; source corruption rejected before inherited execution; full-word and type-sensitive receipt mutation controls; generation refuses overwrite. Independent AI code/proof review by the coordinating agent and a separate proof/native review found no blocker; their exact scope and file hashes are recorded. This is substantial OpenAI Codex-assisted work, not independent human or formal-kernel review.

This is a local same-output improvement, not a complete physical supplier. Storage, movement, precise outer invocation and productive-family coverage, changed numerical defects, and both all-depth supplier caps remain open. The old one-consumer-per-pair fixed-coverage screen rejects 224 H1, but that rate is hypothetical and differs from the actual first-cut frequency; this is explicitly **not a global rejection** or a 224-H1 lower bound. The separate incidence contribution is not an executable dependency.

Canonical main: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Assigned parallel follow-up of #3963; [shared claim and progress](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3963#issuecomment-6262031944). Main was fetched and the binding baseline rechecked before publication. No frontier or selected science changes.

Predecessor credit: ywz65 / #2707 for the full F17 decoder and native normalization; Arham Tahir / #2681 for ordered inverse algebra; retained QQ16/native/geometry lineage; #3952 and #3963 for the motivating demand and boundary audits; Nick Petalas / #3339 for the conditional consumer-budget accounting boundary. Exact source heads and adapted code are recorded in `PREDECESSORS.json` and `SOURCES.json`.

One bounded follow-up was rejected before publication: replacing the 104 corrected W query copies by borrowed current Y gives a nominal 120-H1 word, but the full routed replay fails at `Z0`. All 104 W ports have already received inverse-prefix corrections (the eight T ports also receive Z); the bypass loses their future-query contribution. The 120-H1 nominal bill is not an implementation. The published 224-H1 word and receipt remain unchanged.


Registered local replay also passed: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE outcome=completed`. After replay, one extra EOF blank line in `budget.py` was removed with parsed-AST equality checked; the complete scientific word and receipt are unchanged. Final byte/source-history preflight is recorded below.

Final published head: `400df7fca8f60c19bf163c77564fe3fbe9154b04`, created through GitHub. `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` checked all 37 package/input paths against this head and confirmed canonical source-history ancestry; the base-to-head whitespace check passed. Final metadata/source-pin validation passed after the EOF-only cleanup.


Hosted verification passed in [run 39219936311](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39219936311) for head `400df7fca8f60c19bf163c77564fe3fbe9154b04`. Completed logs confirm the synthetic merge `cba74ef20f825a22eb229daaea2f9440b6259999` into canonical base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, CPython 3.12.15, the complete primary verifier, normal/optimized and Git-free replay, all word/receipt/source/overwrite controls, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The final committed-input check passed with no diff. Workflow conclusion: success at 08:09:05 UTC. This verifies the registered local contract and evidence; physical hosting, numerical-error and all-depth supplier obligations remain open.
